annotations.title: Household electricity use and cost calculator

description: Use for how much electricity an appliance or a home uses and what it costs in Poland: kWh and PLN a month and a year from power and hours. For tariff rates only, use get_energy_prices. Electricity use (kWh a month and a year) and cost of household appliances in Poland at the price per kWh from the URE tariffs in force today: G11, energy with excise, variable distribution, quality, RES and cogeneration fees, VAT; fixed fees are excluded because they do not depend on one appliance. Give appliances by key from the reference list (fridge, kettle, washing machine, TV and more) with optional own values, or by power in watts and hours per day. Result ranks appliances by yearly cost. Without appliances, it returns the reference list with yearly kWh and cost.

appliances.description: Appliances. Each item: key from the reference list (e.g. "lodowka", "czajnik", "pralka", "bojler") and/or watts with hoursPerDay. Omit for the reference list.

key.description: Key from the reference list; omit for an own appliance.

monthsPerYear.description: Default 12, or the reference value (seasonal use).

watts.description: Average power while running in W (rating plate or energy label).

area.description: Distribution operator for the price, e.g. "Tauron", "PGE", "Enea", "Energa". Omit for the mean of operators.

pricePerKwh.description: Own price per kWh in PLN with VAT (from the contract); replaces the tariff price.
